FFTester Web Service Overview (Page 3/37): Test programs exchange data with Flexflow via local .NET assembly (Windows) or remote web service (non-Windows clients recommended). Interface provides three methods: GetUnitInfo (called *before* testing to query unit information), SaveResult (called *after* testing to submit pass/fail status and measurement data), and Test Genric function (generic method for test execution). Control flow: Operators scan unit serial number (SN) → call GetUnitInfo; if RetCode=0, perform test → call SaveResult; if SaveResult RetCode=0, scan next unit; if SaveResult RetCode≠0, backup local test result copy and report error. If GetUnitInfo RetCode≠0, report error without testing. No test performed if initial SN scan fails. RetCode=0 indicates success for both methods.
